ai.summary: In this Help Net Security interview, Lindsay Kaye, VP of Threat Intelligence at HUMAN Security, talks about what AI-generated malware looks like on the bench. She points to tidy comments, uniform logging messages, and emojis as signs a script came from a model, and notes that decompiled code strips much of that away. ai.title: What AI-generated malware looks like under the microscope

general.summary:
On October 21, 2026, Node.js announced the availability of fixes for multiple vulnerabilities across the following supported release lines: 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x. These vulnerabilities impact critical operations such as the Brotli decoder, DNS resolution, and TLS certificate validation. The vulnerabilities pose risks for remote code execution and traffic interception. For more information, see Node.js Security Release . The following vulnerabilities have a Security Impact Rating (SIR) of High and are addressed in this advisory: CVE-2026-111497 - Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write; potential remote code execution CVE-2026-105482 - DNS resolution truncation involving embedded NUL characters CVE-2026-105483 - TLS hostname validation bypass using fullwidth IP digits CVE-2026-106069 - TLS hostname validation bypass with noncanonical IP addresses For information about Splunk products and offerings, see Vulnerabilities in Node.js (CVE-2026-111497, CVE-2026-105482, CVE-2026-105483, CVE-2026-106069) on Splunk Products - October 2026 This investigation was expanded to cover Brotli outside of Node.js on October 30, 2026. The Brotli decoder flaw (CVE-2026-111497), which is in the Google Brotli C decoder, is often bundled with or linked to other software, so products beyond Node.js may be affected. For software that may be affected, see Broccoli2Shell . Important: If a product is not listed within this advisory, Cisco's review indicates that the product is not affected by this vulnerability. This advisory will be updated as additional information becomes available. This advisory is available at the following link: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-oct2026-node-js-Jj3SQ19u
Security Impact Rating: High
general.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js and Brotli Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026

general.summary: フランスの銀行グループCredit Mutuel Arkeaは、外部委託先のシステム経由でサイバー攻撃を受け、不正送金されたと発表した。被害額は数千万から1億ユーロ規模とみられ、暗号資産に交換された可能性がある。銀行自身の口座が悪用されたため、顧客資産への直接的な被害はないという。
general.title: 仏銀行Credit Mutuel Arkeaにサイバー攻撃　委託先経由で侵入、不正送金の被害は約1億ユーロか

general.summary: 仏血液機構（EFS）は、冷蔵設備を管理する委託業者がサイバー攻撃を受け、3施設の冷蔵室の温度制御システムで異常が発生したと発表した。監視システムが迅速に検知して製剤を別設備に移したため被害はなかった。同国では10月にもスーパーの冷蔵設備が攻撃される事件が起きているが、関連は不明だ。
general.title: 仏血液センターの冷蔵設備にサイバー攻撃　温度設定を不正変更、血液製剤への被害は回避

general.summary:
A vulnerability in the authorization mechanism of Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to obtain an endpoint identity certificate. This vulnerability is due to improper authorization checks. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted request to an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to bypass authorization to obtain an endpoint certificate. Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability. There are no workarounds that address this vulnerability. This advisory is available at the following link: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-ise-cert-mE9BD5GO
Security Impact Rating: Medium
CVE: CVE-2026-20241
general.title: Cisco Identity Services Engine Authorization Bypass Vulnerability

general.summary: A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin. The flaw, CVE-2026-58868, affects Android 14 through 17. Phones get the fix with security patch level 2026-11-01 or later, which phone makers and carriers send on their own schedules. As of November 4, Google's bulletin did not report
general.title: Google Issues Patches for Critical Android Flaw That Could Allow RCE Without User Interaction

general.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create arbitrary files on affected installations of MailEnable. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.4. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-114556.
general.title: ZDI-26-869: MailEnable Save Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Creation Vulnerability

general.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ashlar-Vellum Cobalt. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-121744.
general.title: ZDI-26-870: (0Day) Ashlar-Vellum Cobalt XE File Parsing Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
